purpose: Post-sync drift detection for reusable template-canonical governance surfaces.

discovery.rule: Every file under an engine-managed root is tracked, minus the reasoned exclusions below. No extension allowlist: an allowlist is how the coord/scripts/agent entrypoint stayed invisible. Regenerate with `node coord/scripts/template-sync-discovery.js --write`.

exclusions.reason: Project-owned board state. coord/engine/docs/GCV4_ENGINE_CONFIG_SEAM.md names `board/tasks.json` project-owned in its Target Layout, and the Upgrade Contract requires upgrade to preserve board state rather than copy it. Its bytes change on every governed mutation, so a checksum over it would assert nothing about engine integrity and would make the check permanently red.

Project-owned per-ticket plan records written by the governance lifecycle, not engine source. Same Target Layout / Upgrade Contract basis as board/tasks.json: upgrade preserves them, so they carry no engine-integrity signal.

discovery.curated_extras_note: Items with discovery="curated-extra" live OUTSIDE the engine-managed roots (installer surface contract, legacy documentation redirects, .claude/settings.json). No root rule claims them, so they remain hand-listed and are preserved across regeneration.
discovery.history: COORD-607 replaced hand curation. Before it, membership came from a static 2026-04-12 maintainer inventory snapshot and 256 engine files were untracked and therefore invisible to check-template-sync.sh and gov verify-engine.

notes: This manifest tracks the engine-managed surface by RULE (COORD-607); the source_inventory reference below is historical provenance for the original seed, no longer the membership authority.
The manifest does not include itself, to avoid recursive self-hashing.
Run `coord/scripts/check-template-sync.sh --audit-coverage` to verify coverage is still closed; it fails when an engine-managed file is untracked.

include_when: path is under one of discovery.engine_managed_roots
path is not matched by a reasoned discovery.exclusions entry
plus curated extras outside the roots, marked discovery="curated-extra"

enforcement.exact: Missing files or checksum drift fail the check.
enforcement.advisory: Reserved for future mixed-surface monitoring; advisory drift warns by default and fails under --strict.
